sentences.text: Shri R. S. Yadav - Advocate for the appellants.
Ms. Ranjana Agnihotri - Government Advocate for the res Heard on admission.
The appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Learned counsel for the appellants does not press I.A. No.30245/2024 for the appellant no.2-Kailash Lodhi and appellant no.3-Dinesh Saini.

Accordingly, I.A. No.30245/2024 is dismissed as not pressed for appellants no.2 and 3.
Heard on I.A. No.30245/2024, an application under Section 430(1) of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant no.1 - Anil Lodhi arising out of judgment dated 04.10.2024 delivered in S.T. No.117/2022 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Goharganj, District-Raisen (M.P.).

The appellant no.1 has been convicted under Section 420 (15 count) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years (on each count) with fine of Rs.3,000/-
(on each count) and Section 409 (15 count) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years (on each count) with fine of Rs.3,000/- (on each count) with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that Anil Lodhi is in incarceration for more than 05 years & 09 months.
The Trial Court has convicted the appellant and there is no evidence against the appellant.
The appeal is not 2 CRA-12892-2024 going to be decided in near future and it is arguable case on merits.
Hence, the substantial jail sentence of the appellant no.1 be suspended.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application.
Heard the parties and perused the record.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case that the case is arguable and the final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, I deem it proper to suspend the jail sentence of the appellant no.1-Anil Lodhi.

Subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant no.1-Anil Lodhi is hereby suspended and it is directed that the appellant no.1 be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only)
with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court with a further direction to appear before the concerning trial court on 17.07.2025 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by the trial court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
